description: Type is for leaf nodes: select, value, expr_proxy, function

Expr is for leaf nodes, the expression to evaluate: - for Type: select, it is the column name to select or substitute with env var substitution if it contains the char '$'. - for Type: value, it is the value to use or substitute with env var substitution if it contains the char '$'.
ExprPos is for leaf nodes for Type select, it is the 0-based column position to select, it is an alternative to Expr which is the column name.
ExprList is for leaf nodes with multiple values, used for the `in`` operator.

MaxEnvVarSubstitution indicates how many loop of env substitution to do for Expr containing the char '$', default to 3. For non leaf nodes, Op is the operator: and, or, ==, !=, >, >=, <, <=, etc. Special case for type: expr_proxy, it indicates that the expression is a proxy for another expression, the actual expression is specified by one of: - ExprEnvVarProxy: the expression is specified by an env var, the value of the env var is the actual expression as a json string to evaluate. (more to come) Special case for type: function, it indicates that the expression is a function call, the actual function is specified by Expr, and the arguments are specified by Farg. Default value to use when the evaluation returns error

description: How input_column is serialised. An override rather than the answer: the encoding is read off the input channel's column_encodings entry when there is one, and a disagreement between the two is a build failure.

description: Cap on the records reported to the log and the error channel.

description: What to do with a record whose render failed: pass_through sends it on with the output column left unwritten, drop discards it, fail stops the run.

Channels this operator writes beyond the step's own output_channel. The builder resolves each one and hands the resolved channels to the factory, so the operator names nothing its own step did not declare.
notes: Added 2026-09-18. It is error_channel's shape pluralised and for the same reason: the channel registry is withheld from OperatorEnv, so the one use an operator genuinely needs is resolved by the builder and handed over. Registered by the channel registry construction through siteOutputChannelConfigs (compute_pipes.go:253), which is the same door errorChannelConfig uses and for the same argument - the passes that make a channel exist run where no operator registry is present. Declaring both output_channel and output_channels is admitted (clustering and anonymize are the built-in precedent); a name repeated inside the list is refused. Unreviewed: the extension is JetStore's to accept.

description: Keys of the document's own lookup_tables entries this operator reads. Declaring one is what keeps the table from being pruned before it is loaded; the builder resolves each key to the loaded table and hands them to the factory.
notes: Added 2026-09-18. output_channels' shape on the other thing OperatorEnv withholds: lookupTableManager. Bare keys rather than objects because a lookup reference is its key, which is how map_record's lookup columns, anonymize, shuffling and clustering each name one. Read by SelectActiveLookupTable through siteLookupKeys, which is the pass that decides a table is loaded at all and which runs in the starter where no operator registry exists - so without this list the table a site operator needs is pruned away. An undefined key is refused there by name. Unreviewed: the extension is JetStore's to accept.

description: The site's own configuration, carried verbatim: JetStore does not decode it, validate it or know its schema.
notes: json.RawMessage rather than map[string]any so the factory can unmarshal it into its own type and validate it, which is the whole benefit of the site owning its configuration. The document crosses a process boundary as JSON twice and UnmarshalComputePipesConfig is a plain json.Unmarshal, so a block that is not a JSON-tagged field here is dropped silently.
